This is finite evidence killing that matrix, not an asymptotic theorem about every Beneš compiler.

The Lean file establishes only that an integral square Gram isometry is a signed permutation, with no admitted axioms reported. It proves no compiler, L1 kernel identity, CVP soundness, hardness reduction, or dimension-dependent gap.

Pro's CONTINUE recommendation itself concedes that its proposed audit lacks an explicit brick, matrices, finite colors, and residual scale; therefore it is not an executable bounded experiment and cannot justify continuing this run.
